agentName: Access To Deploy Changes to Production
displayName: Agent Name : Access To Deploy Changes to Production
author: rakesh.shukla
description: On-demand agent. The user signs in to GitHub (SSO + authenticator); the agent then opens each configured repo's Settings > Environments, clicks Configure prod-apply (deployment protection rules / who can deploy), stamps date/time and saves a screenshot.
home: C:\WORKSPACE\Multi Agent\CUS Audit\Access To Deploy Changes to Production

outputs.screenshotNamePattern: <repo> Access To Deploy Changes to Production <YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>[ (n)].png
outputs.zip: <agent name> <YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>.zip (this run's screenshots, in the output folder)

safety: Human performs authentication; no credentials are stored or handled by the agent
Aborts on GitHub restriction/rate-limit page; never retries or evades it

changelog.notes: Initial release of this agent. Derived from Branch Specific Write Access v1.0.3 (login, Okta/SSO wait, restriction abort, pacing). Targets Settings > Environments > production.
Target is now Settings > Environments > Configure prod-apply (configurable via --env or inputs.environment) instead of production. Manifest records environment and environmentOpened.
Highlighted capture banner (light background chips for repo name and date/time, larger text, inserted at top of page); zip of the run screenshots as "<agent name> <YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>.zip".
